invariants.rationale: The method sets the write statuses of result before return, so getWriteStatuses() should not be null.
The index update duration is always set in this method before return.
Write statuses are set from the result of updateLocation; their sizes should match.
The parameter writeStatuses is used without null checks, so it must not be null.
The parameter result is used to set multiple fields; it must not be null.
